 Park Jinyoung Live in Manila 2026: Ticket Prices and Seat Plan Announced
 Korea Entertainment Entertainment and Celebrity News Events & Nightlife 
 October 26, 2026 
 Jia Pizarro Bote 
 Good news! The ticketing details for Park Jinyoung’s “1ST CONCERT TOUR [CODE#]” in Manila are finally out.
 Photo: Jinyoung/Instagram
 Three Angles Production announced the ticket prices and seat plan for the upcoming show, slated for December 5 at the FYM Hall, EVM Convention Center.
 The ticket prices are as follows: 
 VVIP: P12,500
 VIP: P9,500
 CAT 1: P7,500
 CAT 2: P5,500
 The fan benefits for VVIP include a group photo (1:15), sound check, hi-bye session, and an official photocard. They also have the chance to win a signed poster (50 winners).
 Tickets go on sale on Sunday, November 1 (12:00 PM) http://tapyourtickets.com.
 Park Jinyoung is a K-pop idol and a member of the beloved boy group GOT7. Outside of the group, he is also known for his acting performances in hit Korean dramas like “Yumi’s Cells,” “The Devil Judge,” “He Is Psychometric,” and “Our Unwritten Seoul,” among others.
